units.source_text: You don’t have to take Oliver’s experience as a recipe for yours. I’m including it because it is one reason I take the “metta first” possibility seriously.

units.source_text:
But if you know that sitting with intense internal material can destabilize you, there are gentler ways to explore what meditation can do.
I’d start with metta. If that felt steady and I still wanted more, maybe trauma-informed mindfulness or Mindfulness-Based Stress Reduction with a therapist. If I still wanted a retreat after that, I’d ask Plum Village, or any other retreat I was considering one thing: what happens if I start destabilizing? Is pausing the practice treated as an ordinary option?
